falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes at least 6% below its level at the start of this 14-day window, or prints a daily close below the August 2024 swing-low analog
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 78% bottom_2024_aug match and HOLD are wrong: analogous support has failed and the unresolved-bottom stance is invalidated

falsification_conditions.condition: Blowoff score prints at or above 70 on any session within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A score of 37 and an unknown/hold phase cannot stand; the tape has entered a blowoff regime inconsistent with a bottom analog

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 30 and ICE BofA US High Yield OAS widens by 75 basis points or more versus the window start, both within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Cross-asset stress confirms a risk-off break, so UNKNOWN/HOLD is false and the phase is a breakdown rather than an unresolved bottom

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
